From Bráulio
“Stolen Books asked me in 2016 if I wanted to publish something through them. I told them I did so many posters that year that it would be enough to fill a book. We published “2016” and then for 2017 I decided to compile all the other work I was doing since I had just quit my job and started my own studio, so these books are now a compilation of not only posters but also record covers, editorial work, videos, sketches, stuff I do for myself, failed experiments, etc.”
